subject: general
question: In January 2022, who released 'Banking on electric vehicles in India' report in collaboration with Rocky Mountain Institute and RMI India?

options.text: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways

solution:
The correct answer is __**NITI Aayog**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NITI Aayog** released the 'Banking on electric vehicles in India' report in collaboration with Rocky Mountain Institute and RMI India in January 2022.
 
• The report focuses on the financial sector's role in accelerating India's electric vehicle (EV) adoption.
 
• It provides a roadmap for banks and non-banking financial companies (NBFCs) to increase their lending to the EV sector.
 
• The report highlights the importance of financing in achieving India's EV goals and reducing carbon emissions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NITI Aayog** stands for National Institution for Transforming India.
 
• It was established in 2015 to replace the Planning Commission with the aim of fostering cooperative federalism.
 
• NITI Aayog acts as a policy think tank of the Government of India and provides directional and policy inputs.
 
• Rocky Mountain Institute (RMI) is a US-based non-profit organization that focuses on sustainability and energy efficiency.
 
• RMI India is the Indian subsidiary of Rocky Mountain Institute, working on similar goals within the Indian context.
